title: Ines and the Oath
author: J. M. Ashgrove
blurb: Marguerite Coldharbour, a bone-carver who hears the dead, has spent ten years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
